editorial.description_en: The blue-green that forms on copper left outdoors. The most chromatic of the light entries here, and the clearest blue-green in the corpus.
editorial.description_ja: 外に置いた銅にできる錆のような、青緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.742, C 0.062, h 178.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 銅 (dō, copper) + 錆 (sabi, rust or patina). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Copper Patina" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 銅錆. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ishi-midori at ΔE00 8.4, kawa-goke at ΔE00 8.9, shio-iwa at ΔE00 10.2. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
